meta.title: کاشی — دموی زنده
meta.author: KaroRostampour
meta.description: Try Kashi, the code-first WordPress page builder, with a ready-made demo page.

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
update_option( 'kashi_lang', 'fa' );
update_option( 'kashi_calendar', 'auto' );
$dir  = WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/kashi';
$pats = json_decode( file_get_contents( $dir . '/assets/patterns.json' ), true );
$tr   = 'fa' === 'fa' ? array() : (array) json_decode( (string) @file_get_contents( $dir . '/languages/fa.json' ), true );
$raw  = array();
foreach ( array( 'hero-split', 'features', 'categories', 'products', 'stats', 'testimonials', 'faq', 'cta' ) as $pid ) {
	foreach ( $pats as $p ) {
		if ( $p['id'] === $pid ) {
			$raw[] = array( 'uid' => substr( str_replace( '-', '', $pid ), 0, 12 ), 'name' => isset( $tr[ $p['name'] ] ) ? $tr[ $p['name'] ] : $p['name'], 'code' => $p['fa'], 'full' => true );
		}
	}
}
$id = wp_insert_post( array( 'import_id' => 1000, 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => 'دمو کاشی', 'post_name' => 'kashi-demo' ) );
$r  = new ReflectionClass( 'Kashi' );
$nb = $r->getMethod( 'normalize_blocks' );
$nb->setAccessible( true );
$cb = $r->getMethod( 'compile_blocks' );
$cb->setAccessible( true );
$blocks = $nb->invoke( null, $raw );
update_post_meta( $id, '_lsec_blocks', wp_slash( $blocks ) );
update_post_meta( $id, '_lsec_scope', '1' );
update_post_meta( $id, '_lsec_untrusted', '0' );
update_post_meta( $id, '_lsec_compiled', wp_slash( $cb->invoke( null, $blocks, true, true ) ) );
update_post_meta( $id, '_lsec_enabled', '1' );
update_post_meta( $id, '_lsec_layout', 'full' );
update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
update_option( 'page_on_front', $id );
